summary: Follow Builders 今日捕捉到 30 条 X 动态、1 集播客、0 篇博客；本站精选 10 条高信号内容。

featured.title: Thibault Sottiaux · OpenAI Codex & ChatGPT 负责人
featured.summaryEn: The most concrete community update this week came from OpenAI's Codex/ChatGPT lead. He directly addressed the "secret nerfing" rumors: GPT-5.6 Sol stays in Go/Plus/Pro subscriptions until an even better model ships. More importantly, several engineering-side disclosures — they landed inference optimizations and are passing the savings to all subscriptions (roughly 10% more usage on its own); the context limit had been bumped to 372k from 5.5's 272k, which caused more usage to be charged than intended, so they reve…
featured.insightZh: 本周社区最实在的一条更新来自 OpenAI 的 Codex/ChatGPT 负责人。他明确回应了近期关于「模型被偷偷削弱」的质疑：GPT-5.6 Sol 会继续留在 Go / Plus / Pro 各档订阅里，直到有更好的模型接替。更关键的是几条工程侧披露——他们上线了推理优化，把省下的成本直接返还给所有订阅用户（预计单这一项就多出约 10% 用量）；此前把 GPT-5.6 Sol 的上下文上限从 5.5 的 272k 提到 372k，结果导致计费用量超预期，现已回滚到 272k，后续会逐步稳妥地放回 372k；同时修掉了 high/xhigh 推理档下 multi-agent 用量偏高的问题。整体基调是「不削弱、只加料」，并暂时继续不启用 5 小时限额。

featured.title: Aaron Levie · Box CEO
featured.summaryEn: Box CEO Aaron Levie framed an architectural question every enterprise AI decision-maker should sit with: as so much intelligence gets packed into AI models, how do you maximize your corporate IP — decisions, insights, workflow patterns, best practices? You might think this gets "bitter-lessoned" out of existence, but the reverse is true: when any firm has frontier intelligence, how you leverage it uniquely becomes the critical question. That's why enormous value sits between the enterprise and the underlying AI —…
featured.insightZh: Box CEO Aaron Levie 抛出了一个值得每个企业 AI 决策者思考的架构命题：21 世纪商业的核心问题之一，是当海量智能被塞进 AI 模型后，你如何把自己公司的 IP——决策、洞察、工作流模式、最佳实践——价值最大化。直觉上人们会以为这些都会被「苦涩教训」抹平，但现实恰恰相反：当每家公司都能用上前沿智能时，「你如何独特地利用它」反而成了最关键的问题。这也是为什么企业与底层 AI 之间有巨大的价值空间——为工作流建 evals、能在不同智能层级间路由模型、以能改进自身工作流的方式捕获 traces、确保信息价值随 AI 变强而复利。应用 AI 层的机会正在于此。

featured.title: How Nuclear Will Unlock Energy Abundance with Valar Atomics Founder Isaiah Taylor
featured.summaryEn: The explosive power demand from AI compute is pushing nuclear toward its "Ford/Tesla moment" — the winner won't be the company with the best simulations, but the one that actually builds reactors, turns them on, and iterates on hardware fast. Recorded at Valar Atomics' Utah nuclear facility, Isaiah Taylor (founder/CEO) argues energy is a commodity where demand is set by price — make it 10x cheaper and demand will come. Today's massive AI-compute power demand is the historic opening for a nuclear restart. Taylor's diagnosis of why the US stopped building reactors is sharp: the trigger was Three Mile Island (no deaths, no injuries, zero public radiation dose, but a badly mismanaged PR situation), yet the deeper problem is that once an industry stops, restarting is extremely hard. Over the dormant decades, the US atrophied at large-scale civil infrastructure but got much better at advanced…
featured.insightZh: AI 算力对电力的爆炸性需求，正把核能推向它的「福特/特斯拉时刻」——赢家不是模型模拟最精的公司，而是敢真正把反应堆造出来、点着、快速硬件迭代的公司。 Valar Atomics 创始人兼 CEO Isaiah Taylor 在犹他州的核设施里录了这期 No Priors。他的核心论断是：能源是商品，需求由价格决定——如果你能让能源便宜 10 倍，需求自然会来。而当下 AI 算力对电力的巨大需求，正是核能重启的历史机遇。 Taylor 对「美国为什么停止建核反应堆」给出了很清晰的诊断：直接导火索是三哩岛事故（虽然无人死亡、无人受伤、对公众零辐射剂量，但公关和舆论处理得一塌糊涂），但更深层的问题是——一旦一个产业停摆，就极难重启。而在停摆的几十年里，美国从「擅长大规模土木基建」退化了这项能力，却在「先进制造」上变强了。所以他的判断是：重启核能不会再像六十年代那样搞土木工程，而要走「制造」而非「建造」的路——反应堆是被制造出来的，不是被施工出来的。 他还揭了行业的一个底：Valar 之外的核工业本质是「建模与仿真产业」，产出的是预测精美的「纸上反应堆」，这是为了绕开监管的「先有鸡还是先有蛋」困境（要拿数据去找监管，但要有数据就得先跑过一座反应堆）。Valar 的破局方式是走 DOE（能源部，其前身 ERDA 本就是为核测试而设、被遗忘了四十年的法律路径）而非 NRC 的商业部署路径。他们身后这座反应堆就是在川普政府 EO14301 行政令下、在 DOE 授权下点着的——要求三座先进反应堆在 7 月 4 日前于美国本土达到临界。安全设计上最关键的一点：他们要演示 scram 后关掉全部电力和冷却系统，靠 RCCS 水套的被动自然循环（水沸腾—蒸汽带走热量—冷凝，无任何运动部件、零操作员输入）在两天内自然移除衰变热——让物理本身保证不会熔毁，这是规模化到成千上万座反应堆的前提。

items.title: Guillermo Rauch · Vercel CEO
items.summaryEn: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch made the point crisply: make the model a cog in a machine you own — don't outsource your brain. He laid out Vercel's open stack: AI SDK as open model API, an open Agent API, and AI Gateway as open ZDR inference. The thesis: startups and enterprises alike must own their data, evals, model choices, and software layer. It rhymes with Levie's take — in an era of converging model capability, ownership itself is the moat.
items.insightZh: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch 一句话点题：把模型变成你所拥有的机器里的一个齿轮，而不是把大脑外包出去。他给出了 Vercel 的开放栈组合——AI SDK 作为开放模型 API、开放的 Agent API、AI Gateway 作为开放的 ZDR 推理层。核心主张是：无论初创还是大企业，都必须掌控自己的数据、evals、模型选择和软件层。这与 Aaron Levie 的观点形成呼应——在模型能力趋同的时代，「拥有权」本身就是护城河。

items.title: Amjad Masad · Replit CEO
items.summaryEn: Replit CEO Amjad Masad shared a "Vibe Research" example: fine-tuning a Qwen-8b model to play chess on Replit, running three parallel branches with different experiments and making real progress. His observation carries weight — models have come astonishingly far at doing ML (they used to be terrible), so someone with good intuition to guide the process could now do interesting ML work even having never done it before. A first-hand data point on AI lowering the expertise barrier, not just a talking point.
items.insightZh: Replit CEO Amjad Masad 分享了一个「Vibe Research」的实例：他在 Replit 上微调一个 Qwen-8b 模型来下国际象棋，同时跑三个并行分支做不同实验，并取得了实质进展。他的感慨很有信息量——模型做 ML 的能力进步惊人（过去它们在这方面很糟），以至于现在一个有良好直觉的人，即便从没做过 ML，也能靠模型引导流程做出有意思的 ML 工作。这条对「AI 降低专业门槛」的判断是一手实证，而非空谈。

items.title: Nikunj Kothari · FPV Ventures 合伙人
items.summaryEn: FPV Ventures' Nikunj Kothari threw cold water on the agent frenzy. He meets so many people in SF claiming they're tokenmaxxing with subagents looping everything — but when he asks "what" and for "whom" they're building, few can give a straight answer. Even in this insane AI era, simplicity and direction still matter ridiculously. Before you let your tokens go brrr, spend time thinking about whether what you're building (for a living) is actually important. Time is literally the only thing you don't get back.
items.insightZh: FPV Ventures 的 Nikunj Kothari 给这波 agent 狂热泼了盆清醒的冷水。他说在旧金山遇到太多人号称自己在「tokenmaxxing」、有一堆 subagent 在循环跑东西，但当他追问「你在为谁、造什么」时，很少有人能给出直接的答案。这说明即便在这个疯狂的 AI 时代，简单和方向感依然极其重要。在让你的 token 疯狂燃烧之前，先花点时间想清楚你正在造的东西（作为谋生手段）是否真的重要——时间是唯一你拿不回来的东西。

items.title: Zara Zhang · Builder（Follow Builders 作者）
items.summaryEn: Follow Builders' author Zara Zhang shared an immediately usable workflow trick: "meeting transcript as PRD." She discusses a feature's implementation with a colleague, sends the transcript to Codex, and it builds the prototype as discussed — the meeting is the prompt. A concrete pattern for agentic coding in practice, worth trying directly. Her other note reads like a creed: passion is the biggest moat.
items.insightZh: Follow Builders 项目作者 Zara Zhang 分享了一个立刻可用的工作流小技巧：把「会议记录当作 PRD」。她和同事讨论一个功能的实现，把会议转录发给 Codex，Codex 就照着讨论内容把原型搭出来——会议本身就是 prompt。这是 agentic coding 落地的一个很具体的实践范式，值得团队直接试。她另一条则更像信念宣言：热情才是最大的护城河。

items.title: Peter Yang · AI 教程创作者
items.summaryEn: AI tutorials creator Peter Yang focused this week on how AI companies communicate with their communities. He noticed a common failure: when sentiment turns negative, companies tend to communicate less and more corporately. His argument is the reverse — communicate more humanly, be transparent about what's happening, solve problems together. He said Anthropic makes great models but doesn't understand why they communicate the way they do, arguing they need to engage the community as directly as OpenAI does. A remind…
items.insightZh: AI 教程创作者 Peter Yang 本周把焦点放在「AI 公司怎么和社区沟通」上。他观察到一个通病：当社区情绪转向负面时，公司往往倾向于沟通更少、更官腔。他的主张恰恰相反——应该更人性化地沟通、对社区透明地讲清楚发生了什么、一起找解决方案。他直言 Anthropic 模型很好，但不理解为什么沟通方式如此，认为他们需要像 OpenAI 那样更直接地与社区互动。对做企业 AI 产品和开发者关系的人是个提醒。

items.title: Sam Altman · OpenAI CEO
items.summaryEn: Sam Altman posted a lighthearted but signal-bearing call: he'd love to see interesting things people built with 5.6 Sol, and will send whoever makes the coolest thing a special gift from the OpenAI archives. This 13K-like tweet is essentially OpenAI drumming up community showcases for the new model — a neat counterpoint to the Thibault and Peter Yang threads on how AI companies engage their communities.
items.insightZh: Sam Altman 发了条轻松但有信号意义的号召：他很想看到大家用 GPT-5.6 Sol 做出的有意思的东西，会给做出最酷作品的人送一份来自 OpenAI 档案库的特别礼物。这条 1.3 万赞的推文，本质是官方在为新模型的社区展示造势——与前面 Thibault、Peter Yang 关于「AI 公司如何与社区互动」的讨论正好互为注脚。

items.title: Claude · Anthropic
items.summaryEn: Anthropic's official account announced a limit adjustment: extended Claude Fable 5 access on all paid plans, and Claude Code's weekly rate limits stay 50% higher, through July 19. The mechanics — you can use up to half your weekly usage limit on Fable 5, then continue with usage credits or switch models to keep working within remaining limits. A practical operational note; teams leaning heavily on Claude Code can plan their week around it.
items.insightZh: Anthropic 官方账号发布了限额调整：所有付费计划对 Claude Fable 5 的访问延长，Claude Code 的周限额继续保持高出 50%，一直到 7 月 19 日。规则细节是——每周可用一半的用量额度在 Fable 5 上，用完后可以用 usage credits 继续，或切换到其他模型在剩余额度内工作。这是一条实用的运营信息，重度用 Claude Code 的团队本周排产可以据此安排。
